properties.notes: Former commercial garage premises that has latterly been vacant. Now offers chance for infill, although the existing buildings would require demolition prior to redevelopment. The main building was originally a chapel, which had latterly been converted to a garage for vehicle maintenance and servicing. Relatively high yield representative of location and previous proposals for an apartment scheme that would be in keeping with setting. An earlier application for clearance and construction of 10 apartments was approved but lapsed (07/00250/FUL). A subsequent application to extend time limit was submitted but then withdrawn (10/S/00570/VARYCO). Therefore the original permission lapsed. The current availability of the site is uncertain. There still may be potential in the long-term but no residential development is forecast within the plan period at present.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
